provenance: Original tool outputs transcribed after the review. The archived script reconstructs the original probes; probes were not rerun when archiving.

regex.method: Each input runs in a fresh isolated Node subprocess with a 2000 ms parent timeout. Measures /^(a+)+$/.test(line.slice(0,4000)), the same synchronous matching operation used by file_search.
regex.limits: Microprobe of the actual matching expression, not an end-to-end file_search/HTTP test. One measurement per input; timings are machine-specific. Timeout establishes a lower bound, not the full completion time.

anthropicDuplicateState.method: Create ResponseBuilder, feed one Anthropic content_block_start with 65536 ASCII x characters, finish and finalize, then compare stored message JSON, the same object without providerState, default estimateTokens, and anthropicMessages wire serialization. Uses existing compiled dist modules.
anthropicDuplicateState.limits: No external provider call. Serialized bytes and default heuristic token counts are measured; these are not actual provider tokenizer counts or process RSS. This probe covers Anthropic text only, not Responses or signed reasoning.

redaction.method: Independent RedactionScope(mode=registered) for each count. Register synthetic dummy-key-{i}- plus 24 k characters. Redact 128 KiB of ASCII z with no matches five times and report the median. Close every scope.
redaction.limits: Synthetic scaling probe, not a claim about current production credential counts, refresh rates, or retained heap. No real credentials are printed.

scope: Read-only product-source review. No external model/network/desktop operations. No additional stress testing during evidence archival.
